credentials.label: Servers to monitor, one per line. '*' on its own = every server the bot is in. 'GUILD_ID' or 'GUILD_ID=*' = that server, every channel. 'GUILD_ID=ch1,ch2' = that server, only those channels. GUILD_ID is the Server ID (enable Developer Mode, then right-click the server > Copy Server ID). Channel filtering cannot be combined with '*'.

description: reads + sends Discord chat and mod commands. Needs a bot token + Server ID (enable the Message Content intent and invite the bot with Read/Send/Moderate perms).
name: discord-adapter
